text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Here we go, it's the Sapporo Kinen, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there's a tree decorating the corner of the room.
Is that...
choice_data_list: That's a lilac tree, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Is that really its name?
Why would a tree like that be...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there's a description written here. The lilac is
Sapporo's city tree. I see, I see...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Aha!? Trainer, I just realized
something incredible! This is super auspicious!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Lilac... means 'incoming good fortune'!
If I don't get great results with this, it's gotta be a lie!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
This is practically in the bag now. Praying away~
O God of the North, O great Kamuy~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Grant me good fortune, please~.
And I'd also love to eat some Jingisukan~.
